verdicts.remediationRecommendation: Remove roleId from req.body in register endpoint; default to lowest privileged role or restrict user creation solely to authenticated admins.
Sanitize and redact sensitive keys (password, newPassword, currentPassword, token) before serializing req.body in auditLog middleware.
Update layout.js sidebar rendering to show Omborxona (stock-in, stock-out, inventory) and Suppliers for Operator role or check granular permissions using Auth.hasPermission().
Use row-level locking (tx.$queryRaw`SELECT * FROM "Product" WHERE id = ${productId} FOR UPDATE`) or atomic decrement update (currentStock: { decrement: quantityDecimal }) with DB check constraint.
In updateStockIn, verify that if (newStock < 0) throw new Error('Omborda yetarli mahsulot yo\'q').
Whitelist allowed sortBy columns and sortOrder values ('asc', 'desc') in controllers, and handle PrismaClientValidationError gracefully in errorHandler.js.
Use JSON.stringify(name).replace(/"/g, '"') or data attributes (data-id and data-name with addEventListener) instead of inline single-quoted onclick strings.
Set API_BASE = window.location.origin + '/api' or use relative path '/api'.
Check if product or supplier has dependent transactions before deleting, or switch to soft-delete (isActive: false), and handle Prisma P2003 error code in errorHandler.js.
In notification.routes.js update query, add condition where: { id, userId: req.user.id } or check admin privileges.
Implement PUT /api/notifications/read-all on backend and invoke it in Layout.markAllRead().
Create low-stock notifications with userId: null (broadcast) or notify all admin users.
Add validation rules in product.routes.js PUT route for purchasePrice, salePrice, and minStock with isFloat({ min: 0 }).
Remove unused express-session and cookieParser from server.js to conserve memory and avoid security misconfigurations.
Call await prisma.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: id } }) when password is reset by admin in user.controller.js.
Normalize endDate in backend routes by setting time to 23:59:59.999 before applying gte/lte filters.
